Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0043 2026-10-21
MEETING NOTES — Preparing the Structures Topics for
Friday :
Date: 2026-10-21
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Attendees: PERSON-0001 for TEAM-0001; documentation team's
coordinator; backlog chair; station records clerk.
Purpose: Prepare structures topics for the Friday queue sweep
at 09:10. ISSUE-0001, TASK-0001, and TASK-0002 locate the
discussion folder for DEMO-AIR-0001.
Decisions The chair will ask each submitting desk for the
decision needed, owning team, next action, and next review
date. Topic headings are due by 16:00 on 2026-10-22. The
Friday appointment remains a twenty-minute coordination
review, so collecting questions in advance matters.
Use a question parking margin for background that needs a
separate response. Keep an addressee and promised reply date
beside each parked question, and carry it forward with the
main agenda sheet. A margin label alone is not enough for the
next coordinator to resume the discussion.
The documentation team's coordinator will identify which
attachment heading is needed for the review. Keep that
collection action separate from the chair's choice of
discussion order. No priority proposal is established by an
agenda position.
Action items
— Owner: PERSON-0001. Due: 2026-10-22 at 16:00. Submit the
structures decision question.
— Owner: Documentation coordinator. Due: 2026-10-22. Supply
the collecting role and attachment heading.
D. Worker 0001
Demo Worker 0001, Demo Team 01
